_source: identified from belyaev_kushnarev.csv (221150 rows, 576 rays) by tools/robotino_ext.py --identify
_model: per motor and sample index k of the ray (k >= N-1: steady state): [w_k, tau_k] = coef . [w_{k-1}, tau_{k-1}, m_vel, m_setvel, m_vol] (w_-1 = tau_-1 = 0); cur_k = coef . [cur_{k-1}, |tau_k|, |tau_{k-1}|, |U_k|, |U_{k-1}|, |w_k|, |w_{k-1}|, |m_vel|, |m_setvel|, m_cur, m_cur_{k-1}, 1]
